cohort: The study included 118 patients who underwent a caesarean section at one community hospital between November 2015 and May 2016.
finding: The crude surgical site infection rate after caesarean sections was 5.9%, with NHSN risk-adjusted rates of 6.1% for risk level 0, 5.9% for risk level 1, and 0.0% for risk levels 2 and 3.
